answer: The reveal must open the same hollow hash, and a reveal that arrives late or mismatched is dropped at the plume gate. Copying becomes a race the farming party always loses, and producing 67 original texts is the only way to fill 25 aliases; the ember log preserves both halves. Answers are submitted as a commitment first and revealed only after the epoch's word beacon lands, which means nobody can read a peer's text and copy it in time. That is 31 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
